about_the_game:
Free to Play

Clicker Ore

Grab your pickaxe, descend into the depths, and become the master of wealth!

Clicker Ore is a mining game that combines idle clicker mechanics with RPG depth and a high sense of progression.
Every click makes you stronger. Every level brings a new challenge.
Your journey in the depths of the mines transforms into an endless adventure of gaining power.

Why Clicker Ore?

Start simple, become a giant.
You start with a single pickaxe, and over time transform into a real power machine with dozens of equipment, skills, and golems.
Wrong investments slow you down, the right move multiplies your power.

The depths await you.
As you descend, difficulty increases, temperature rises, and rocks become stronger.
To maintain your power, upgrade your armor, use your resources wisely, and progress by defeating each boss.

Never stop.
Prestige, earn Essence, and get permanent enhancements.
Each restart makes you stronger.

Core Features

• 8 Upgradeable Skills – Develop your abilities with Skill Stones, determine your playstyle
• Boss System – Battle unique bosses, earn special rewards
• Prestige & Essence – Reset your progress but become exponentially stronger with permanent bonuses
• Dynamic Quest System – Complete quests of varying difficulty, spend Taskium, and earn rare rewards
• Leaderboard – Prove your power, take your place among the best miners
• Trade System – Exchange currencies seamlessly and freely
• Title System – Unlock titles that grant bonuses
• Pet System – Increase your progression speed with loyal companions

Strategy or Power?

Clicker Ore isn't just about clicking.
The right pickaxe, the right armor, the right investment at the right time.

It combines the comfort of an idle game with the strategic depth of an RPG.
Wrong decisions slow you down, right decisions carry you to the top.

Are you ready?

🔧 Early Access

Clicker Ore is under active development.
Content, balance, and systems are constantly updated with community feedback.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3) or Intel Core i5 (2018 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple integrated GPU (M1/M2/M3) or Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon Pro
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

name: Clicker Ore

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel UHD 630 / AMD Vega) or dedicated GPU equivalent to NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
